title: yorkshire pudding pan
text:
yorkshire pudding pan. I have to admit, I wasn't expecting much - but this pan is weighty. It looks and feels like quality. Time will be the test and I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
UPDATE 6/25/2022 - This pan is so useful for so many things and has lasted like gold. I just purchased 2 more. They are very worth every dime.

product_metadata.title: MasterClass 4 Hole Yorkshire Pudding Tray with PFOA Non Stick, Robust 1 mm Carbon Steel, 24 cm
features: Heavy Duty Commercial Weight Non Stick Pan
Each Hole is 4 inches Diameter by 3/4 inch Deep
Ideal for Yorkshire Pudding and Individual Tarts
description: Never again have trouble trying to get your Yorkshire puddings out of the tray with this non-stick 4 hole Yorkshire Pudding Tray. It is 24 cm in size and makes four large 10 x 2cm Yorkshire puddings to please your family. The heavy duty steel tray can be put in the dishwasher, oven, fridge and freezer and comes with a twenty year guarantee.
